ordering_evidence.assertions: The supplied operation and run identities commit before RunStarted and provider open. Cancellation during acceptance awaits the admitted write and records actual local cancellation without provider work.
A second SQLite connection cannot see a paused precommit event, then reads committed partial text while provider completion remains blocked.
Whole-batch preflight precedes intent; committed intent precedes execute; shared serialization/cache precedes exact result commit; result commit precedes finish and continuation.
Runtime completion and final record delivery remain distinct. The first failed operation and observed RunResult are retained; a committed final record cleanup warning still returns Executed.

The example reads partial runtime history while the first response is pending and exact tool output while the continuation request is blocked inside generate, then verifies final result and no-work reopen.

failure_and_drop_cases.assertions: Lookup, acceptance, runtime and result failures retain stage, attempted operation, receipt/certainty and proven committed prefix without retry.
Real SQLite busy and constraint cases preserve static errors and exact execution boundaries.
Committed intermediate cleanup warnings stop later work; final committed cleanup remains known completion.
Drop, abort and panic quarantine ownership in isolated children. Fresh-process reopen preserves prefixes, interrupts once and starts no provider, tool or continuation.
A deterministic saturated current queue reports slow_consumer/Unknown truthfully, commits only delivered events once, and performs no retry or continuation.

performance_limits: These are single finite local WSL/filesystem observations with warm artifacts, scheduling, barrier reads and operation-scoped connection open/validation/commit/close. They are not benchmarks, percentiles, fastest claims or SLAs. Zero WAL bytes were observed after close and do not measure transient WAL volume.

matrix.assertions: Baseline 34b4cfd is an ancestor of planning HEAD 7087f50. Dirty, untracked, staged, toolchain and gate state are recorded without replacing current counts with P1-A counts.
Public run retains its synchronous non-Send FnMut callback. Public run_persisted uses the same run_admitted loop, preserves supplied UUIDs and yields a Send future owned by an explicit Tokio task.
Actual S1/S2 snapshots and all ordered definition fields are compared once before acceptance. Stored original/prepared/provenance bytes are used without reread.
Existing validation and error codes reject invalid input/options/provider/features/transport/caller tools/registry/pre-cancellation before acceptance, provider open or tool work.
Matching duplicates return the original acceptance and current run before current dependencies; conflicts remain conflicts; no old accepted operation starts work.

Concurrent absent lookups coordinate through weak keyed acceptance ownership. One identical caller executes; the loser returns Duplicate. Session active-run and independent-session behavior remain intact.
Acceptance precedes RunStarted/open; supplied run UUID, provider identities, source sequence and session sequence remain distinct; rename does not rewrite runtime identity.
Real text, one-tool and two-cycle loops use the shared controller/registry and store exact input, events, results and returned RunResult with expected open/request/execute counts.
Precommit rows are invisible, committed partial text is readable while provider work is blocked, and no full-run buffering or precommit publication occurs.
Native/effective values, recovery provenance, usage, indexes, Unicode/control data and opaque JSON are compared as parsed values/exact strings without reconstruction or diagnostic leakage.
Full preflight precedes any intent/effect. Valid terminal response commits before intent, and committed intent precedes execute. Cancellation during intent commit leaves intent but no effect.
Success, ToolFailed gateway_error, tool_output_limit and error-shaped Ok preserve exact shared serialization and actual is_error. Cache and result commit precede finish and next request.
Reuse emits current correlated reuse, retains original result request identity, appends no second result and performs no reread/effect. Cache scope remains per run.

All required cancellation boundaries await admitted storage, preserve completed actual results, fabricate no pending result and stop before later effects; existing no-call completion selection remains.
Final event and final record failures preserve actual Completed RunResult, sink/delivery failure, first operation identity and any already committed terminal state without synthetic replacement.

Session-open/provider/incomplete/failed/local-cancel outcomes are stored as actual outcomes. Upstream not_submitted/unknown/terminal_received and malformed output handling remain truthful without fallback.
Injected and real SQLite cases retain first stage/operation/receipt/outcome/certainty and committed prefix. No writer retry, replay or fake rollback occurs; lookup does not restart work.
Acceptance and intermediate committed cleanup warnings stop future work and expose receipts. Final committed cleanup returns Executed with actual completion and warning.

The crate-private hold reuses drain accounting without DB/session/maintenance locks. Close signals local cancellation, rejects writes, drains hold and SQL, then releases a healthy lease without deadlock.

Never-polled futures do nothing. Drop/abort/panic after acceptance or during waits closes core provider and quarantines unfinished ownership until child exit, with no fabricated terminal or early owner.

Accepted, partial text, intent, success-result and error-result prefixes survive fresh process reopen; interruption occurs once; terminal controls remain unchanged; old duplicates never execute or resume.

The current 64-slot queue is saturated against paused SQLite. Success commits every claimed event once in source order; deterministic slow_consumer commits only delivered events and reports Unknown without retry or false continuation. Production queue/timeouts are unchanged.
Public persisted execution uses one WebSocket/two frames, previous_response_id and result-only continuation. Accepted input, committed tool bytes, native terminal and recovered output remain exact.

Public persisted SSE uses two requests and exact effective native-history replay, including missing-MIME admission. Malformed identity and failed admission preserve established failure/uncertainty without fallback.

Global/project metadata is advertised without bodies. Exact selected main-file bytes or gateway_error commit before continuation; deletion reuse does not reread; invalid authority fails whole-batch preflight; resources/scripts stay inert.

Dropped history waiters do not own or cancel backend execution. A second reader recovers Running history. Rename remains valid and two sessions isolate all identities, histories and results. No browser callback is in persistence.

Debug/Display expose only static stage/category. Sensitive canaries are absent. Public errors retain existing maps; only acceptance/final receipts or current failed operation are held while explicit APIs expose stored output/result.
